items.title: Approve the Minutes of the October 8, 2019 Meeting
Adopt the SOMA Youth and Family Zone Community Engagement Final Report [NTIP Planning]
Approve San Francisco’s Program of Projects for the 2020 Regional Transportation Improvement Program
Approve of Amendment No. 4 to the MOA with TIDA for Yerba Buena Island Vista Point Operation Services
Allocate $24,253,024, with Conditions, and Appropriate $49,724 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds for 22 Requests
Accept the Downtown Rail Extension Peer Review Panel’s Final Report on Governance, Oversight, Management and Project Delivery
Hearing on Traffic Enforcement in support of Vision Zero
Update on the Geneva/San Jose Intersection Study
